suite: r1108 contextual passive presentation health evidence
method: Production health collector and presenter execute against bounded synthetic cached presentation snapshots. Historical events and lifecycle checkpoints are round-tripped with audio commands, recovery calls, database access and network trapped.
limitations: This deterministic VM suite does not verify raster pixels, native browser semantics, physical Android return from lock, or audible sound.
